name: Service Agreement
description: Agreement for a provider delivering defined services to a client for a fee.
title: SERVICE AGREEMENT
subtitle: between {{ client_name }} and {{ provider_name }}

fields.label: Client
fields.help: The organisation paying for the services.

fields.label: Services to be provided
fields.placeholder: design, build and maintain a demand forecasting dashboard
fields.help: Describe the scope of work. Completes the sentence 'The Provider shall ...'.

fields.label: Fee
fields.help: Include the currency and whether it is per month, per milestone or fixed.

fields.label: Payment terms
fields.help: When the client must pay after being invoiced.

fields.label: Termination notice (days)
fields.help: Notice either party must give to end the agreement early.
